resources.string: Copy a command and paste it into a terminal on your Ubuntu or Linux computer. The app does not run it for you.
The installer checks the pinned download before installing it. OpenCode listens only on this computer; use USB or an authenticated tunnel to connect your phone.

Copy includes the complete installer bundled with this app, followed by the selected command. It writes ubuntu-opencode.sh in the current folder. Install keeps an existing OpenCode 2; Update never migrates OpenCode 1 or downgrades a newer version.
With the phone connected by USB, run this on the computer to forward the server port.
